notes: All locales generally follow the brief's core requirements for a fictional discovery corner project, including name, two-sentence description, and one paper-based activity.
The image scenarios for the independent mission (Fantasy Garden) are genuinely different from the discovery corner scene, as required.
Privacy and age suitability are consistently addressed in educator notes and through the emphasis on fictional content.
The 'mustTeach' elements (task, defect/correction, AI vs student) are present across all locales, though some explanations and activity structures need refinement to be fully explicit.
The 'avoid' requirements (no certificates, no auto-publishing, no external AI accounts) are implicitly met as no such features are included in the drafts.
